title: Saab Magalona’s husband Jim Bacarro undergoes vasectomy
summary: Saab Magalona shared that her husband, musician Jim Bacarro, has undergone a vasectomy after they had decided they no longer want to have another child. Magalona shared the news in an Instagram post…

blocks.text: Saab Magalona shared that her husband, musician Jim Bacarro, has undergone a vasectomy after they had decided they no longer want to have another child. Magalona shared the news in an Instagram post on Saturday, Nov. 21, accompanied by photos of Bacarro at the hospital before and after the procedure. The singer-actress said they had been discussing birth control options after her contraceptive implant expired when Bacarro told her his decision to undergo a vasectomy. “That’s right.
